page.overview:
What is Charis Black?

Charis Crouch (née Black) (1919–1973) was a pure-blood witch and a member of the noble House of Black. She was the third daughter of Arcturus Black and Lysandra Yaxley and the youngest sister of Callidora and Cedrella. She was married to Caspar Crouch, and produced three children: a son and two daughters.

Through her disowned sister Cedrella, she was a maternal aunt of Arthur Weasley and a relative of the Weasley family, and through her other sister Callidora, she was related to the Longbottom family.

Charis is named after the (singular Charis), the Greek goddesses of charm and beauty. The Greek charis means "grace, kindness".

Like her mother Lysandra and her sister Callidora, Charis is named after a type of butterfly or moth, specifically a butterfly genus of the Riodinini tribe.
